about_the_game:
A cozy fantasy management game where you build and run a tavern for adventurers. Serve humans, dwarves, and elves, gather rumors from your customers, and turn those into quests to grow your fame and expand your tavern.

Key Features

Build & Customize Your Tavern
Design the perfect layout and decorate your space with furniture, lights, kitchens, beds, and more to create an efficient and inviting tavern.

Serve a Diverse Crowd
Cater to humans, dwarves, and elves—each with unique food and drink preferences. Keep them satisfied to earn gold and boost your reputation.

Rumors into Quests – A Living Progression System
Instead of a traditional tech tree, progress through stories! Gather rumors from customers, then transform those rumors into quests that brave adventurers will embark on. Send heroes off to slay monsters, find treasures, or solve mysteries – and reap the rewards when they return. Each completed quest can unlock new recipes, rare decorations, or special upgrades for your tavern, making progression feel organic and full of adventure. Your tavern becomes more than a business; it’s the heartbeat of heroic tales in the realm.

Grow Your Fame
As your reputation increases, unlock new races, advanced recipes, bigger upgrades, and special events that expand your tavern’s possibilities.

Manage with Depth, Play at Your Pace
Hire and assign staff, manage resources, and optimize service flow. Enjoy a low-stress experience that still rewards smart planning and attention to detail.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 Home 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 6100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GeForce™ GTX 970 (4 GB) | AMD® Radeon™ RX 480 (8 GB)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 Home 64 Bit | Windows® 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-6700K | AMD® Ryzen™ 7 2700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GeForce™ GTX 1070 (8 GB) | AMD® Radeon™ RX 5600 XT (8 GB)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
